senses.gloss: अदुःख [aduḥkha], a. [न. ब.] Free from evil, propitious. -Comp. -नवमी the propitious 9th day in the bright half of भाद्रपद when women worship Devī to avert evil for the ensuing year.
अदुच्छुन [aducchuna], a. Ved. Free from evil, propitious. पवमानस्य ते रसो मदो राजन्नदुच्छुनः Rv.9.61.17.
अदुपध [adupadha], a. A word with अ as the Penultimate letter (P.III.1.98.).
Not inaccessible, not difficult of access.
Destitute of forts; ˚विषयः an unfortified country.
अदुर्मुख [adurmukha], a. Ved. Unremitting, zealous, cheerful; यस्याजुषन्नमस्विनः शमीमदुर्मुखस्य वा Rv.8.75.14.
अदू [adū], a. Ved. Not zealous, dilatory; not worshipping; आदुवः Rv.7.4.6.

अदूर [adūra], a. Not distant, near (in time or space); ˚वर्तिनीं सिद्धिं राजन् विगणयात्मनः R.1.87; ˚उज्झितवर्त्मसु मृगद्वन्द्वेषु 1.4; ˚त्रिंशाः Sk. not far from 3, i. e. nearly 3; ˚कोपा हि मुनिजनप्रकृतिः K.142 easily provoked, irascible.-रम् Proximity, vicinity; वसन्नदूरे किल चन्द्रमौलेः R.6.34; त्रिंशतो$दूरे वर्तन्ते इति अदूरात्रिंशाः Sk.; अदूरे, -रम्, -रेण, -रतः, -रात् (with gen. or abl.) not far from, at no great distance from; अदूरे प्रियासमागमं ते प्रेक्षे V.3 not far distant, very near. -Comp. -भव a. not being far off, +being near. (P.IV.2.7).
अदूषित [adūṣita], a. Not vitiated, uncorrupted, unspotted, irreproachable; ˚धी possessing an uncorrupted soul.
